environment.label: Oxygen below 19%; pressure 116.8 kPa and above
environment.note: One cell of the coverage grid (coverage.json): the oxygen bin o2_lt19 and the pressure bin p_ge116_8. The bin edges are the team's choice. No flow range and no gravity level are set. Oxygen bins: 21% with the +/-2.0 point control box (EAWG.atmospheres); 30% is the Moon Base lower bound in the challenge text and the current worst-case test oxygen (CH.moonbase; TB14639.worstcase); 36% is the highest exploration design value, 34% (EA.8.2-34, EAWG.testing), plus the same 2-point box, which is the team's extension. The challenge text gives no upper oxygen bound. Pressure bins: Edges are midpoints between pressures named in the references: 55.2 kPa (8.0 psia), 70.3 kPa (10.2 psia) and 101.3 kPa (14.7 psia) (EAWG.atmospheres, CH.moonbase). The upper edge of the 101.3 bin mirrors its lower edge. FLEX tests set to 0.7 atm are recorded at 70.2 to 72.6 kPa, so a bin around 70.3 is used instead of a strict 'at or below 70.3'. The bins are wide: the bin around 101.3 kPa spans 85.8 to below 116.8 kPa, against a control box of +/-0.2 psia in EAWG.atmospheres, and the lowest edge is built from 8.0 psia while the 8.2 psia atmosphere (EA.8.2-34) falls in the same bin.
